expectations.says: The pressure written as 110/ gives a systolic row of 110 and no diastolic row.
expectations.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS systolic, SUM(CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 3012888 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diastolic, MAX(m.value_as_number) AS value FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000811' AND m.value_source_value = '110/'

expectations.says: The pressure written as a word gives no row.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000811' AND m.value_source_value = 'unrecordable'

expectations.says: The pressure written correctly gives one systolic row and one diastolic row.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000811' AND m.value_source_value = '100/60'
